V1.scale: Measured: 512 levels (1024 bytes) completes within the 256 KB stack probe cap; 1024 levels (2048 bytes) exceeds it. Per-level stack cost approximately 250 bytes (two frames: readArray + readMain). Extrapolating linearly to the evaluation 1 MB stack with approximately 50 KB base overhead: about 4000 nesting levels to cause StackOverflowError. Densest encoding is one byte per opening bracket (overflow occurs during descent before closing brackets are reached), so approximately 4000 bytes.
